reader.requirement: At --std 85, for MOVE, ADD and SUBTRACT CORRESPONDING, an item subordinate to D1 or D2 that has a REDEFINES, RENAMES, OCCURS (fixed or DEPENDING ON) or USAGE IS INDEX clause, and every item subordinate to a REDEFINES/OCCURS/INDEX item, must take no part in pairing on either side; and a reference-modified D1 or D2 must be refused.

edition-consulted.switches: DialectLevel < 2002 adds the §1985:VI.6.4.3 GR3 level-66/USAGE INDEX operand refusal; the reference-modification refusal (this rule's last sentence) is the same code at every edition
perPair = DialectLevel < 2002: group operands re-identified per pair (identification time, not the exclusion set)

reader.edition-search: grep DialectLevel|Edition|DialectBehavior in CorrespondingBinder.cs and StatementValidation.cs; the exclusion predicates (CorrEligible, RuleFiveExcludesSubordinates) consult no edition.
reader.behaviour-differs-by-edition: no: the exclusion set and the ref-mod refusal are edition-independent; only operand identification timing (perPair) differs, which this rule does not govern.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: g85_bf04_05 covers ADD/SUBTRACT CORR with REDEFINES, OCCURS, INDEX and RENAMES items on the D1 side; l1c04/pb229 add D2-side REDEFINES groups and OCCURS. Not exercised by witnesses: MOVE CORRESPONDING exclusions, an OCCURS DEPENDING ON group in D1, a USAGE INDEX item on the D2 side, a subscripted D1/D2 table element, and the reference-modification refusal.

probes.printed: A1 A=101 C=100 D=100 F=100 W=100 (D2 REDEFINES C, D2 OCCURS D, F under D2 REDEFINES E, W under D1 ODO group, XI index on D2: all ignored)
A2 A=111 C=100 / A3 A=111 C=000 (subscripted D1 TG (2) and D2 TG (3))
probes.expected: D1/D2 themselves may be table elements; C OF G2 (REDEFINES) ignored both directions

probes.printed: M1 A=AAA CR=--- T=--- F=FFF K=--- P=--- (MOVE CORR)
probes.expected: MOVE CORR ignores REDEFINES CR, OCCURS T, K under REDEFINES H, P under OCCURS M

probes.expected: Neither D1 nor D2 may be reference modified: refused

probes.printed: EXPECT: MATCH; l1c04 MATCH; pb229 identical lines (the .out lacks a final newline, so run_case reports DIFFERS)

OK  §1985:VI.6.4.3 GR3  (║6.4.3 The CORRESPONDING Phrase║)  the text is in GR3

reader.notes: CorrMembers never admits or descends into an OCCURS/REDEFINES/index item, and 66 entries never join Children, so every probed exclusion holds on both sides and for MOVE. The ref-mod refusal is correct at 85, but its message cites §2023:14.9.2.3 SR6 / §2023:14.9.25.3 SR12 instead of §1985:VI.6.4.3 GR4, a citation-only blemish. File organization class (e) does not apply.
